description: This file implements a truncating audit backend for Kubernetes, which processes audit events by potentially truncating request and response objects to limit event size, and manages batching and delegation to an underlying backend.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration for the truncating backend, including maximum event and batch sizes.

classes.name: backend
classes.description: Struct implementing the audit.Backend interface, performing event truncation and batching.

classes.name: sizer
classes.description: Helper struct to calculate size of encoded audit events.

methods.name: ProcessEvents
methods.description: Processes a batch of audit events, truncating large events and batching them for delegate backend.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Removes request and response objects from an audit event to reduce size.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the backend, delegating to the underlying backend.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the backend, delegating to the underlying backend.

methods.name: calcSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of an audit event by encoding it.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the backend.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Implements io.Writer to calculate the size of encoded audit events.
